title: Borderline Crack Widths on Re-Measurement — Calloway Limited Home Warranty Performance Standards
content:
The visit charge of a re-measurement under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty carries a borderline multiplier, applied to the program's reinspection fee.

**Rule.** The borderline multiplier compares the re-measured width — the width measured at the most recent inspection that found the crack within tolerance — with the program's tolerance for the item's defect category (the concrete crack width tolerance for concrete flatwork, the slab crack width tolerance for a foundation slab, the masonry crack tolerance for masonry veneer and the drywall crack tolerance for any other item): a width of 90 percent of the tolerance or more takes 0.60; a width of at least 75 percent but under 90 percent of the tolerance takes 0.80; a narrower width takes 1.00, that is, no adjustment.

## Thresholds in inches (the tolerance figures are the same in every HomeCare program)

| Defect category of the item | Tolerance | 90 percent of it | 75 percent of it |
|---|---|---|---|
| concrete flatwork | 0.25 | 0.225 | 0.1875 |
| foundation slab | 0.1875 | 0.16875 | 0.140625 |
| masonry veneer | 0.375 | 0.3375 | 0.28125 |
| any other item, drywall included | 0.125 | 0.1125 | 0.09375 |

| Re-measured width as a share of the tolerance | Borderline multiplier |
|---|---|
| 90 percent or more | 0.60 |
| at least 75 percent, under 90 percent | 0.80 |
| under 75 percent | 1.00 |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical widths).** A concrete flatwork crack at 0.225 inch is exactly 90 percent and takes 0.60; at 0.22 inch it takes 0.80; at exactly 0.1875 inch it is 75 percent and takes 0.80; at 0.18 inch it takes 1.00. A drywall crack at 0.10 inch is 80 percent of 0.125 and takes 0.80.
